title: AH It's Coming Out (Golden Freddy)
blurb: Only the FNAF fandom could have produced this: the panicked 'AH, IT'S COMING OUT' clip welded onto Golden Freddy, the series' most unexplained animatronic. The result is startling and completely unserious at once, which describes the fandom's entire creative output rather well. Golden Freddy has always been the hollow one, the one who turns up when nothing triggered him, and pairing that with a chaotic scream is either sacrilege or perfect. Nobody has settled the argument. Play it when something appears that had no business appearing.
origin: A FNAF fandom remix combining Golden Freddy with a viral panic clip.
